name: qc-landing-roof
notes: Roof case (bedrock ABOVE), the self-arming idea. A = piston [0,2,0] facing DOWN (head into air at [0,1,0]); target bedrock [0,3,0]. A is powered ONLY by quasi-connectivity, from a redstone block at [1,3,0] beside the cell above A. SP (sticky piston [3,3,0] facing west, held extended by a redstone block at [4,3,0]) pulls that redstone block out: the pull empties [1,3,0] in the block-event phase and never updates A, so A keeps its head and silently loses power (BUD). U (sticky piston [0,2,3] facing north, powered by a redstone block at [0,2,4]) pushes a stone from [0,2,2] into [0,2,1], beside A: that LANDING is in the block-entity phase, after the tick's block events, so the retract event it queues on A is still pending in the next player window. One key press there (attack+use on the same key: break A, place a piston facing UP) swaps in a piston facing the bedrock.
